aiStatement: In Purchase Card Data Segment (Data Segment No. 104), field 10 (Direct Marketing Invoice Number) is conditional and must be present only when its documented condition holds.

facts: Segment 104 field 10 / Element 29 is marked Conditional and identifies an invoice number in a direct marketing transaction.
Chapter 13 describes Element 29's purpose as the invoice number in a Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
The processing rule says the field is used in that request; the cited source excerpt does not specify a transaction flag or other independent activation predicate.
sourceConclusion.separation: SEG104-R-014 concerns format when populated (alphanumeric, maximum ten characters); it does not by itself define conditional applicability.

aiCaseReview.assessment: The bounded screen shows Segment 104 context but Element 29, Purchase Code 80, and PC amounts 72-74 declared omitted in all three cases. It does not establish a Direct Marketing/AVS trigger, nor does it show a populated invoice number.

requiredEvidenceForAdjudication: Authorized definition of the Direct Marketing/AVS condition and how a test proves that condition without relying on Element 29 itself.
Full Segment 104 request fixture in a source-justified direct-marketing context and a contrasting non-DM/AVS context.
Independent Test-owner decision on whether Element 29 omission is permitted outside DM/AVS requests.
Separate format review for a populated invoice number under SEG104-R-014.
